name: Colleagues&Lovers
source:
May is the main character of the game. She comes to new city and starts working in a new company where colleagues don't only have a business relationship. In the first episode, you will see the relationship between some characters. Right at the beginning, May has suitors and colleagues who would like something more with her, but she really likes that one, the relationship with him is hot and cold, and as the game progresses, the story heats up.

[From [url=https://dakidogames.itch.io/colleagueslovers]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅是游戏的主角。她来到新的城市，开始在一家新公司工作，同事们不仅有业务关系。在第一集中，你会看到一些角色之间的关系。一开始，May有追求者和同事想要和她有更多的东西，但她真的很喜欢那个，与他的关系忽冷忽热，随着游戏的进展，故事逐渐升温。

[来自[url=https://dakidogames.itch.io/colleagueslovers]Itch.io[/url]]
